title: permanent_bipedal7 implementation
description:
Implement `permanent_bipedal7` over the F_7 packed type (T19) using `gray_code_iter` and `Packed7Vec::fold_mul`.

## Background

Mirrors the F_3 / F_5 paths: Gray-code walk, packed column-sum updates, fold via the F_7 multiplication tree at each step. Function lives at `gf2-algebra::permanent::permanent_bipedal7`.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-algebra::permanent::permanent_bipedal7(matrix: &Packed7Matrix) -> Fp<7>` exists.
- [ ] [hard] Single-word matrix-size bound documented and matches `Packed7::LANES`.
- [ ] [hard] Output bit-identical to `permanent_ryser<Fp<7>>` (T7) on 1000 random matrices for each $n \in \{1, \ldots, 14\}$ — covers epic success criterion 6.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-algebra --release --profile ci` passes.
